title: P1 world portal request
description: DEC-TUTORIAL-TRANSPORT-20261106 approves POST /p1/world/portal with exactly one client field: portalId. The destination is whatever the server registry says it is, so mapId, x, y, floor, reason and target coordinates have no place here - a client that could name them could teleport anywhere. additionalProperties is false for the same reason the quest verb does not accept a client-chosen questId.

portalId.description: Server-published route ids only, taken from the alpha registry built from docs/production/Map_Production_Atlas_vi.md. TP_BM_THANG_LONG is deliberately absent: Thang Long stays behind C1-06 and is not opened by the alpha chapter grant.
